QuestInfo.name: Costume Preparation, Done!
QuestInfo.0: You've completed the costume preparation, but she says something is still missing. What could possibly be missing? Ask #bLala#k what else she needs.
QuestInfo.1: #bLala#k doesn't think the costumes are going to be enough. They need some perfume! Pink Perfume, Yellow Perfume, and Blue Perfume can be obtained from the #r3rd - 4th Floors of Kerning Square#k.
QuestInfo.2: #bLala#k wasn't sure which scent would go best with which costume, so she gave you some time to think about it. \r\nHm, you don't seem too sure either. Why don't you leave it up to #bLala#k?\r\n
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 7,900\nCan proceed to the Rose Scent quest\n

0.0: Oh, I've figured it out! We need the right fragrance to go with the right costume, duh! Every piece of clothing needs to be complemented with its own scent. That'll make things perfect, don't you think?

yes.0:
Yes, that's it. To become a celebrity, he needs the right hair, makeup, costume, and scent! We have three costumes, so we'll need three different fragrances.
#b Please bring me 15 Pink Perfumes, 15 Yellow Perfumes, and 15 Blue Perfumes#k.
yes.1: Pink Perfume, Yellow Perfume, and Blue Perfume can be obtained on the #r3rd -4th Floors of the Kerning Square#k.

no.0: You didn't think that would be enough, did you?

1.0: Did you bring the Perfumes I've requested? Let's see 'em!

yes.0: Mmm, each perfume smells unique and delicious. Yummy. But I don't know which scent goes with which outfit. What do you think, #b#h0##k? I'll give you some time to think it over.

item.0: Please bring me #b15 Pink Perfumes, 15 Yellow Perfumes, and 15 Blue Perfumes#k. From what I remember, there is a perfume shop on the 3rd-4th floor of Kerning Square.
